title: Gas Station Simulator
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#776, 2026-10-29), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal, rated 4 of 5 after 7 minutes: about 10 fps on an M1 but playable, the Epic copy. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable on an M1 with D3DMetal at about 10 fps (Epic). The game picks High by default. On an M1 the Notebook preset, three steps down, holds about 30 fps (udance4ever, 2026-10-29).

knownIssues.symptom: About 10 fps on an M1 at the default High preset
knownIssues.fix: the Notebook preset, three steps down, gives about 30 fps on an M1
